name: Two-stage compression approach
aliases: Two-stage compression approach — Hybrid CPU/GPU compression scheme
definition: A hybrid CPU/GPU scheme for lossless compression and data streaming that combines a temporal prediction model, variable-length coding, and a fast block compression algorithm, using CUDA to unpack and assemble data packets on the GPU.
summary: The two-stage compression approach is a hybrid CPU/GPU scheme for streaming time-varying volume data that uses the CPU for complex decompression and the GPU for simple operations to overcome bandwidth bottlenecks.
